comments.author: Holfina
comments.body:
I love how people with no concept of supply and demand spout off that it's the greed of the seller that makes an item worth so much. A seller can try to sell anything for any price he/she wants to, but unless there is a DEMAND for it, they will sit unsold until the seller reduces the price.

If you don't like how much they sell for, don't buy them, it really is that simple. If the item truly is overpriced, nobody will buy it and prices will go down. But why on earth call somebody greedy if they KNOW they can put these up for sale at 400-500k and they'll be sold before they wake up the next morning? It would be stupid not to.

Let "N" be the number of PO/QMP reward obtained in JPN server.
Then the number of that in Gama is

comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body:
Someone has figured out a series of quests you can do to earn quite a few PO1s in short period of time. Ill list them here.

First go to Lisbon and do Nostalgic goods

Report the quest at Portobelo and do Deliver fish meat

Once at Lima, report it, and take Items of gratitude

Report at Calicut, then sail to Jakarta to take Deliver duck meat (As Calicut has no PO1 quests. Also, you or someone else will need R3 Cooking to take this part)

Report back at Lima, then take Nutritious vegetables. You can also take any other PO1 quests that goes back to Europe if you want, but your have to sail around SA, or use the train way up in SF to get to Boston since your be carrying trade goods.

Report at Venice, sail back to Lisbon, repeat as desired.

This is best done when bringing 2 other alts as you can get up to 102 PO1s this way, whereas your earn just 34 PO1s if you do it by yourself.
